name: CD
summary: Shiny compact disc with a rainbow sheen and centre hole; use for music, burning discs or 90s media scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: centre y of the disc (floating item, not a floor object)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; disc about 600 px across at s = 1; about 0.3 in a hand

params.name: color
params.note: base disc colour under the sheen

params.name: anim
params.note: spin = the disc turns and the sheen rotates with it
